info.name: ORCA Backend (SIH26176)
info.description:
Team Nautilus - ORCA Marine Intelligence Platform backend.

IMPORT THIS, then set the collection variable `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:4000).

Run the requests top to bottom. `analysis_id`, `conversation_id`, `route_id` and `subscription_id` are captured automatically by test scripts, so later requests work without you copying IDs by hand.

Internal endpoints live on a DIFFERENT port (default 4100) via `internalUrl` and require a signed token - see the guide for how to mint one.
